rebuilds.why: Stem sentence was 25 words against the 16-word cap. Same maths (10 cm by 6 cm rectangle, 4 cm by 3 cm corner removed, area 48 cm²), split into three short sentences; the old 'not to scale' bracket is removed because the row has no drawing. Options keep their values; every distractor now tagged with an execution.

stem.text: An L-shape is made from a rectangle 10 cm by 6 cm. A corner 4 cm by 3 cm is cut out. What is the area of the L-shape?

options.execution: The child works out the whole rectangle, 10 x 6 = 60 cm², and forgets the corner that was cut out. The 4 x 3 = 12 cm² corner has to come off, leaving 48 cm².
The child adds the rectangle's sides instead of finding the space inside: 10 + 6 + 10 + 6 = 32. That is a perimeter, not an area; the area is 60 - 12 = 48 cm².
The child works out the cut-out corner correctly, 4 x 3 = 12 cm², and gives that as the answer. The question asks for what is left, so the step still to do is 60 - 12 = 48 cm².
